plain: Argued or claimed that something is so

webster.text: Urged in argument or debate; disputed; contested.

example.quote: He contended that they were on the same foundation, and that every possible security which existed in the one instance was to be found in the other.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 18, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
